limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Verified developments: Iran war draining US missile stocks with no restock plan (supply-chain signal), US-India deepening defense partnership with Javelin deal corroborated by Canada-India pacts, Pentagon fact sheet rebuking Canada on defense spending and F-35 review, and C-27J fleet upgrade plus Thales radar modernization.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Verified growth forecast revisions: Singapore raising GDP outlook to ~6% on AI boom, S&P cutting India FY28 GDP to 7% with expected December rate hike, IMF raising Hungary's forecast, and central bank projecting 6.0-6.5% GDP contraction.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: IEA declaring first oil supply surplus since Iran war began is a verified market-moving state change corroborated by falling crude prices; European gas surge on cold snap and supply fears; Trump signaling Iran talks; Libya reopening a major oil pipeline.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Verified data points: KBRA record middle-market default rate, Bangladesh loan defaults rising (33.8% and Tk 20,850cr surge), central bank governor warning on cyber threats to global financial stability, and Indian banks' relief measures for stressed agri loan book.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Verified state changes: EU 22nd sanctions package on Russia, US escalation of Iran sanctions, UNSC warning on Black Sea strikes threatening global food supplies, and Ukraine strike on Russian ships in Benghazi condemned by Libya's UN-backed government. These carry material global transmission (energy, shipping, food).

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Authoritative signals: Fed's Williams signaling higher rates over time for inflation (corroborated across sources), energy price shocks pushing inflation to 8.6%, Brazilian market raising inflation/dollar forecasts, and Australian Treasurer warning of persistent inflation with slower growth.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Material state changes: Nvidia halting shipment of US-approved AI chips to China, US blacklisting Megaspeed over Nvidia-linked export concerns, New Mexico AG investigating Google data center deal, and Nvidia board reinstating Jensen Huang driving semiconductor rebound.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Authoritative state changes: US adds Megaspeed to trade blacklist over export controls, EU-Indonesia deal eliminating most tariffs, Canada's 100% tariff on Chinese EVs, and SCOTUS invalidating IEEPA tariffs with ongoing appeals. Cross-theme corroboration on Megaspeed.
